statement: Between 2026-09-27 and 2026-11-30 the United States and Iranian governments both publicly confirm a ceasefire, truce or Strait of Hormuz reopening agreement concluded between them.
resolution: Between 2026-09-27 and 2026-11-30 the White House and the Iranian Foreign Ministry each publicly confirm a US-Iran ceasefire, truce or Hormuz-reopening agreement, corroborated by two of Reuters, AP and AFP; a proposal or talks alone do not count.
failure_condition: No US-Iran ceasefire, truce or Hormuz-reopening agreement is confirmed by both governments with an announcement dated between 2026-09-27 and 2026-11-30.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-31 US Central Command confirms US strikes on at least one target inside Iran located more than 50 km inland from the Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman coasts.
resolution: A CENTCOM or Department of War release names a US-struck target inside Iran more than 50 km from the Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman coast, struck between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-31; vessel and coastal-site strikes are excluded.
failure_condition: No CENTCOM-confirmed US strike on a target more than 50 km inland in Iran takes place between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield (FRED series DGS10) closes at or above 5.50 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-09-28 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 5.18 percent on the packet date.
